name: @lostgradient/terminal
description: Browser terminal component and controller for Corvidae, rendered with the selected terminal engine.

scripts.test: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun ../../scripts/bun-test-junit.ts --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=1 src scripts
scripts.test:renderer: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun test --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=1 src/lib/components/terminal
scripts.test:input: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun test --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=1 src/lib/input
scripts.test:transport: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun test --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=1 src/lib/transport
scripts.test:boundaries: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun test --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=1 scripts/check-boundaries.test.ts && bun scripts/check-boundaries.ts
scripts.test:coverage: TZ=UTC LANG=en_US.UTF-8 bun test --conditions browser --conditions svelte --parallel=1 --no-isolate --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov src scripts && bun scripts/check-coverage.ts
